questions.prompt: Poker bankroll money and living expenses should be…

choices.text: The same account so you can reload from rent.

questions.explanation: Separation is the first safety control. Skill does not remove variance.

questions.prompt: A stranger offers a private stake and wants the password to your account. You…

choices.text: Refuse. Do not share accounts, devices, or credit.
Let them hold your chips overnight.

questions.explanation: Account sharing and informal credit are common theft setups.

questions.prompt: You hit your time limit but you are stuck half a buy-in. You…

choices.text: Must stay until you are even.
May leave. A time limit is allowed to cost money.
Demand the table refund the blinds.

questions.explanation: Stops are allowed to fire while you are stuck. That is what they are for.

questions.prompt: Responsible-play lessons in this app are…

choices.text: Free and not something you should skip to reach 'real' strategy.

questions.explanation: Safety content stays available. It is part of being table-ready.
